title: DxMessaging
description: Connect gameplay systems without direct references between senders and receivers. DxMessaging provides synchronous, type-safe untargeted, targeted, and broadcast messages. Lifecycle-managed registration tokens pair subscriptions with components and dependency-injection scopes. Message Monitor, Flow Graph, Inspector overlays, and runtime diagnostics make routes visible while you develop. Struct messages keep steady-state dispatch allocation-free. Optional samples cover Zenject, VContainer, and Reflex.
keywords: unity message messaging event-bus decoupling type-safe diagnostics debugging performance zero-allocation architecture gameplay
